contract: UR Motion Studio desktop: folder-first program review with Advanced closed by default; one Simulator tab switches live/flight while preserving separate sources; scrolling retains dark chart pixels and pins recorded script-line context. Native ttk theme, labeled keyboard controls, synthetic fixtures only.

accessibility.evidence: Native labeled ttk buttons and selectors retain Tab/arrow-key behavior. Focused UI tests cover input validation, compact controls, source switching and modal guards. Playback is explicitly user-controlled; no decorative animation added.

responsive.evidence: Inspected nine native-window captures at compact and wide sizes. Folder action/results/export remain available; Advanced opens only on request. Simulator source selector and bottom script line fit at 980x620. Flight script axis and line footer stay visible after scrolling at 1000x720.

loading.evidence: Program batch worker exposes progress, disables source/override controls and allows cancellation between programs; mocked transfer tests retain byte progress, cancel and idle timeout.

empty.evidence: UI tests verify no-report/cleared-folder states; offline Live robot provides connection setup. Missing chart channels render explicit unavailable messages, visible in wide flight capture.

error.evidence: Source tests cover invalid installation, ambiguous files and malformed program. Graphical batch test keeps failed programs listed; invalid advanced specification focuses and marks the field.

partial.evidence: Graphical batch regression verifies one valid plus one malformed program preserves successful review/export. Unresolved script lines and telemetry gaps remain unavailable rather than fabricated.

success.evidence: Native report screenshots show matched installation, computed findings and result count. Program UI tests export PDFs; simulator tests switch sources without overwriting live samples or losing recorded position.

permission.reason: No new application permission flow introduced. Existing SSH host verification remains unchanged and covered by mocked trust tests. Capture uses the application window only.
